question: The study of the timing of biological events in plants and animals, such as flowering, leaf production, dormancy, reproduction and migration, etc., is called?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Phenology.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The study of the timing of biological events in plants and animals, such as flowering, leaf production, dormancy, reproduction and migration, etc., is called **Phenology**.
 
• It is the science dealing with the time of appearance of characteristic periodic events such as leaf shedding, fruit ripening etc in the life cycle of organisms.
